verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs show the triage workflow: errors can be assigned to a team or an individual collaborator, including through automatic assignment rules (bugsnag-docs-55, bugsnag-docs-41). Fixed, snoozed and ignored statuses exist as inbox filter states (bugsnag-docs-28), and these actions can be taken from the dashboard via keyboard shortcuts (bugsnag-docs-42) or from Slack (bugsnag-docs-8). Nothing in the pack shows a fixed error automatically reopening when it recurs, which is an explicit half of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic reopening of resolved errors on regression, detailed docs on snooze conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.
